layout: Centered status card. Light bg. Clean, reassuring design.
elements: STATUS CARD: White bg, 20px radius, centered shadow
Icon: Clock/watch icon with subtle pulsing animation (if possible) in navy (#003F8C)
Status label: 'Menunggu verifikasi admin' in slate
Timer/progress info: 'Estimated time: within 24 hours' with clock icon
Progress bar or animated dots showing passage of time (optional)
SUBMITTED DETAILS: Expandable section showing what was submitted (read-only summary)
Name, specialization, gym location, documents uploaded count
'Edit Application' — outline button (blue #003F8C), in case buddy needs to fix something
'Cancel Application' — ghost button (slate #94A3B8), confirmation dialog on tap
SUPPORT INFO: Small text at bottom 'Need help? Contact support@trialfit.com'
notes: Reassuring design — buddy just submitted and is anxious. Clear timeline (24h). Edit option reduces support tickets. On approval: auto-redirect to Schedule Setup screen.
